Publish only claims reproduced on program and held-out corpora with confidence intervals
Qualitative positioning without numbers, labelled as design intent

required_evidence: Benchmarks versus 7z LZMA2 solid, RAR5, xz -9e, zstd --ultra -22 --long, zstd -1, pigz
Decode throughput per profile
Held-out corpus replication (program 35)

question: How should pack handle sources that change during capture: retry count (default 2), stability predicate (Unix full stat set versus Windows length and mtime only), and disposition (abort whole pack, exclude with report, include with unstable_source record, or snapshot integration)?
archetypal_objective: Archives of live trees must be internally consistent or say they are not; aborting everything protects correctness but makes Entrybound unusable on busy systems, while weak predicates silently capture torn files.
hard_constraints: SPEC §5.7a writer produces a consistent archive or declares it could not
SPEC §5.7a unstable file never included silently

candidate_set.description: Status quo: 2 retries, platform-specific predicate, abort entire pack
Exclude unstable files and report them; pack succeeds with warnings
Include last capture with fidelity.unstable_source record
Use filesystem snapshots (VSS, btrfs, ZFS, APFS) when available
Extend predicate with change time and file IDs on Windows, or content re-hash
Include whatever bytes were read without detection or record

required_evidence: Fault injection on NTFS, ext4, FAT and SMB with same-size rewrites
Capture success versus retry count on live trees
Incumbent behaviour under concurrent modification
Snapshot API availability without unsafe code or admin rights
Coordination: Cross-ref access decisions stream-writer-source-instability-handling and local-source-revision-detection.

question: Are the frozen legacy export wrapper parameters right (DEFLATE level 6, xz preset 6 single block, bzip2 level 9, single member/frame), what happens to a frozen wrapper profile when its pinned encoder must be upgraded, and are seekable or multi-block wrapper profiles needed?
archetypal_objective: Exports must be deterministic and widely readable; parameters and single-stream layouts trade size, speed and parallel or seekable decompression for incumbent readers.

candidate_set.description: Status quo single-stream wrappers at fixed levels with pinned encoders
Mint a new wrapper profile ID when any encoder output changes
Add multi-member gzip, multi-block xz and seekable zstd wrapper profiles
Retune levels from measured size and speed
BGZF-style blocked gzip for random access

required_evidence: Cross-platform and cross-version golden vectors per wrapper
Size and speed of alternative levels
Parallel and seekable decoder support in common tools
Coordination: Legacy export semantics are owned by legacy shards; this decision covers codec parameters only.
